name: Automated Lead Follow-Up Sequence

parameters.content:
## Automated Lead Follow-Up Sequence

### How it works

1. The workflow triggers when a new lead form is submitted and processes the lead information to send an immediate acknowledgment email if compliance is met.
2. It logs lead details for follow-up tracking in a Google Sheets document.
3. A scheduled trigger runs daily to check which leads require follow-up emails based on the tracking data and sends compliant follow-up emails accordingly.
4. It monitors if the follow-up sequence reaches a final stage without a response and sends an alert email.
5. The workflow checks incoming email replies from leads, matches them to the tracked leads, and marks them as responded in the tracker to prevent further follow-ups.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Configure webhook credentials or endpoint URL for the 'When Lead Form Submitted' trigger node.
- [ ] Connect and authorize access to the Google Sheets containing lead tracking information for nodes interacting with sheets.
- [ ] Set up and authorize email sending service for 'Send Instant Acknowledgment Email', 'Send Follow-Up Email', and 'Send No-Response Alert Email' nodes.
- [ ] Configure email reading via IMAP in 'When Lead Replies Via Email' node with appropriate credentials and folder settings.
- [ ] Ensure the compliance sub-workflows invoked by 'Check Compliance Before Ack Email' and 'Check Compliance Before Follow-Up Email' are accessible and properly configured.

### Customization

Modify custom code nodes to adjust email content, follow-up timing, or compliance rules to fit specific business needs.

## Lead form submission and acknowledgment

Handles lead form data reception, parsing, building, compliance checking, and sending of the instant acknowledgment email, then logs the lead for tracking.

## Daily follow-up sequence check

Scheduled trigger fetches lead tracking data, computes which leads are due for follow-up, then builds and verifies follow-up emails before sending or skipping based on compliance.

## Final stage no-response alert

Checks if leads have reached the final follow-up stage without response and builds and sends alert emails accordingly.

## Lead reply processing

Handles incoming email replies from leads, parsing sender information, matching replies to tracked leads, and marking the leads as responded in the tracker to stop follow-ups.

nodes.name: When Lead Form Is Submitted
nodes.notes: Wire your inquiry form (JotForm, Typeform, Fluent Forms, or similar) to POST here with the lead's name, email, phone, and practice area.

nodes.name: Parse Incoming Lead Data
nodes.notes: Field names here match common inquiry-form defaults (JotForm/Typeform/Fluent Forms) -- adjust to your actual form's field names if they differ.

nodes.name: Build Acknowledgment Email Content
nodes.notes: One templated body per practice area (family law, estate planning) plus a general default -- edit BODY_BY_AREA here for different copy.

nodes.name: Check Ack Email Compliance
nodes.notes: Real marketing email to a real lead -- opt-out and disclaimer handling here are genuinely load-bearing.

nodes.name: If Ack Email Is Approved
nodes.notes: Mirrors the guardrail's approved/opted-out result.

nodes.name: Send Acknowledgment Email
nodes.notes: Reaches back to 'Build Instant Acknowledgment Email' by name, not $json, since the guardrail call in between replaces $json with its own response.

nodes.name: Skip Ack Email For Opt-Out Lead
nodes.notes: Rare for a first-time inquiry, but respected the same as any other opt-out check in this catalog.

nodes.name: Append Lead To Follow-Up Sheet
nodes.notes: Logs every lead regardless of the acknowledgment email's approval outcome -- follow-up tracking shouldn't depend on that. Reads from 'Parse Lead Submission' by name since the guardrail call upstream replaced $json.

nodes.name: Trigger Daily Follow-Up Check
nodes.notes: Runs daily, 9am by default.

nodes.name: Fetch Follow-Up Tracker Data
nodes.notes: Reads every tracked lead -- filtered to who's actually due for a follow-up in the next step.

nodes.name: Calculate Due Follow-Up Stage
nodes.notes: FOLLOW_UP_STAGES controls the whole sequence — number of stages, spacing, and labels. A responded lead is always skipped regardless of timing.

nodes.name: Build Follow-Up Email Content
nodes.notes: One templated body per stage -- edit BODY_BY_STAGE here for different copy per touch.

nodes.name: Check Follow-Up Email Compliance
nodes.notes: Real marketing email to a real lead -- opt-out and disclaimer handling here are genuinely load-bearing.

nodes.name: If Follow-Up Email Approved
nodes.notes: Mirrors the guardrail's approved/opted-out result.

nodes.name: Send Follow-Up Email
nodes.notes: Reaches back to 'Build Follow-Up Email' by name, not $json, since the guardrail call in between replaces $json with its own response.

nodes.name: Skip Follow-Up For Opted-Out Lead
nodes.notes: Doesn't advance the tracker's stage -- mark the lead responded=true directly in the sheet to stop future attempts cleanly.

nodes.name: Update Tracker Post Follow-Up
nodes.notes: Only updates last_stage_sent and last_sent_at, matched on lead_id -- never touches responded or the other columns.

nodes.name: If Lead Reached Final Stage
nodes.notes: Only the last configured stage (day7 by default) triggers the attorney no-response alert -- earlier stages just send their own follow-up, no alert.

nodes.name: Build No-Response Alert Email
nodes.notes: Internal alert to the attorney -- no guardrail wrap needed, this doesn't go to the lead.

nodes.name: Send No-Response Alert Email
nodes.notes: Internal notification only, not sent to the lead -- no guardrail wrap needed.

nodes.name: Skip Alert For Non-Final Stage
nodes.notes: An earlier stage (day1/day3) -- its own follow-up email already covers this, no attorney alert needed yet.

nodes.name: When Lead Replies By Email
nodes.notes: Watches the same inbox FIRM_FROM_EMAIL sends from, via IMAP. Credential: Credentials → New → IMAP → your mailbox's server/login details.

nodes.name: Parse Reply Email Sender
nodes.notes: Extracts the replying address so it can be matched against the tracker in the next step.

nodes.name: Read Tracker For Reply Match
nodes.notes: Reads every tracked lead so the replying address can be matched by email.

nodes.name: Match Reply To Lead Tracker
nodes.notes: Matches by exact email address — a reply from an address not in the tracker is simply ignored.

nodes.name: Mark Lead As Responded In Sheet
nodes.notes: Only updates the responded flag, matched on lead_id -- stops all future follow-up emails to this lead immediately.

Mark Lead As Responded In Sheet

description: Fires when a new inquiry-form lead arrives: sends an instant acknowledgment email through the Bar-Compliance Guardrail and logs the lead for follow-up tracking. Separately, a daily check advances each still-unresponsive lead through a configured follow-up sequence (Day 1/3/7 by default) one stage at a time, alerting the attorney directly if the final stage passes with no response. Separately, an inbox watcher marks a lead responded the moment they reply, stopping future follow-ups automatically. Replaces manual lead follow-up tracking; conversion bridge to a full CRM pipeline at higher lead volume.
